newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bandai says expects to approve Sega merger May 28.
newsitem.headline: Bandai says expects to approve Sega merger May 28.

text.p: Toy maker Bandai Co Ltd said on Monday that it expects its board to approve at a meeting on May 28 a planned merger with Sega Enterprises Ltd, withdrawing an earlier plan to postpone approval until July.
At the beginning of this year, Bandai and Sega announced that they would merge on October 1.
There had been speculation that the merger could be delayed due to strong opposition from mid-level managers at Bandai, according to Japanese media reports.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Monday that Bandai's board in early May voted to delay approval until July, citing opposition from within the company.
Bandai's business has been boosted by the huge popularity of its "Tamagotchi" electronic pet toy.
Japanese media also reported over the weekend that Bandai employees opposed the planned merger.
